Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)
about a year ago

For more open and equitable public discussions on social media, try “meronymity,” researchers suggest. They found platforms whose users reveal only certain verified aspects of their identity empowered less confident participants to speak up.

Researchers designed a communication framework that enables academics to ask for research help on social media using “meronymous” communication, in which the asker only reveals certain verified aspects of their identity. This approach encouraged people to ask questions they otherwise might not h...
